skill: Entering a Peer Conversation & Joining Play
learning_objective: Child observes ongoing play, requests to join appropriately, and accepts turn-taking terms.

curriculum.module: Entering a Conversation & Joining Ongoing Activities
target_rules: Wait for a brief pause in the activity
Ask to join with a friendly, open request
Accept the peer's terms or turn-taking order without argument

scenario: You see your friend playing cricket at the playground. You want to join the game.

feedback.hint: Ask your friend nicely if you can join the game!

next_character_reply.tanglish: Seri va! Aana adutha round la nee dhaan batting pannanum.
next_character_reply.tamil: சரி வா! ஆனா அடுத்த ரவுண்ட்ல நீ தான் பேட்டிங் பண்ணனும்.

prompt.tanglish: Seri va! Aana adutha round la nee dhaan batting pannanum.
prompt.tamil: சரி வா! ஆனா அடுத்த ரவுண்ட்ல நீ தான் பேட்டிங் பண்ணனும்.

feedback.hint: Say okay and thank your friend for letting you play!
feedback.gentle_correction: A friendly reply is: 'Seri da, thank you!'

next_character_reply.tanglish: Super! Bat eduthutu vaa, start pannalam!
next_character_reply.tamil: சூப்பர்! பேட் எடுத்துட்டு வா, ஸ்டார்ட் பண்ணலாம்!

completion.success_message: Awesome! You joined the cricket game using polite turn-taking!
